jobs.title: Tablet korekta 1
jobs.prompt: Use case: compositing. Produce ONE high-resolution landscape photographic architectural visualization by editing the FIRST image. Preserve its exact camera, booth geometry, walls, white outer rectangular frame, original four tablets and labels, cabinet, table/chairs, factory TV, remaining linear suspended fixtures, all furnishings and hall background. No new booth structure, no additional screens, no people. The right branding wall MUST remain a simple clean ivory wall with only the exact coordinated PRESCOT LED logo above the smaller red KLUŚ wordmark and text "OFFICIAL DISTRIBUTOR", as in the input. No spherical lamp there. The rear-left forward-facing wall, directly LEFT of the TV, is the ONLY place for EXACTLY THREE upright BLACK LED reels, dim/medium/bright warm-white SAME color temperature. Use the supplied reel photograph (image2) as product identity. Three tapes emerge from these reels and visibly MERGE to exactly ONE LED tape. Never RGB. The reels/tape are FLAT PRINTED wall mural graphics; not physical objects in the room. Keep left wall's four tablet category labels "TAŚMY LED", "ZASILANIE", "AKCESORIA", "STEROWNIKI". Maintain flawless Polish text. No new slogans or specs. No watermarks, labels outside booth, split panels, collage, UI or red annotations. Continuous inside-corner LED mural, airy ivory art direction. On rear-left wall place three large upright reels on a shared baseline, leading three gracefully spaced luminous tails merging CLEARLY into ONE ribbon before crossing the inside corner to the LEFT wall above tablets. That single ribbon forms a wide low elegant wave, leaving generous clean area for the exact large bold headline on left wall: "1 taśma. 3 jasności.". Position headline near upper left and emphasize numeral 3 in PRESCOT orange. Keep all imagery warm-white, clean and architectural. Different composition from source while keeping geometry.
